# Tri-State Bed Bug K9 Council

> Independent bed bug scent detection certification for K9 teams in New York, New Jersey and Connecticut. Dogs are tested on live bed bug odor only. The Council runs blind field evaluations on live bed bugs, publishes a public registry of certified K9 teams, and offers in-field verification of K9 teams for New York City property managers, hotels and organizations.

Key facts:
- Coverage: New York, New Jersey and Connecticut. In-field verification program focused on New York City.
- Standard: one handler and one dog search a building of at least four rooms in about 15 minutes; two live bed bug hides and two distractors; must find both live hides with no more than one false response; any alert on a distractor fails. Two evaluators observe; evaluators may not test teams they trained or employ.
- Bed-bug-only dogs (no dual-scent dogs). Credentials are valid 12 months.
- Field evaluation is free; certified teams pay a $225 annual registration.
- The Council is fully independent: it does not train dogs, sell inspections or provide pest control, and evaluators may not test teams they trained or employ. Contact is through website forms only.

- [Standards](https://k9council.org/standards): The bed bug scent detection standard: live bed bug hides, distractors, blind conditions and pass criteria for certified K9 teams.
- [Applications](https://k9council.org/applications): Request a bed bug scent detection evaluation for your K9 team in New York, New Jersey or Connecticut.
- [Certified Teams](https://k9council.org/certified-teams): Verify a K9 team's bed bug scent detection credential. Search certified teams in NY, NJ and CT.
- [Verification](https://k9council.org/field-verification): In-field bed bug K9 verification for NYC property managers, hotels and organizations. A Council evaluator tests the dog team you hire, on site at your property.
- [FAQ](https://k9council.org/faq): Bed bug K9 FAQ: how to tell if a bed bug dog is legit, certification and verification, plus NYC, NJ and CT landlord and tenant bed bug rules.
- [Resources](https://k9council.org/resources): Guides and articles on bed bug scent detection, K9 field evaluations and hiring a certified bed bug dog team.
- [Contact](https://k9council.org/contact): Contact the Tri-State Bed Bug K9 Council about bed bug scent detection certification.
- [Registry badges](https://k9council.org/badges): Registry badges for certified bed bug K9 teams listed with the Tri-State Bed Bug K9 Council, with embed code that links to each team's live listing.
